test_title: PYST 08: SSC JE EE - General Intelligence (Held on 06 Jun 2024 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:** Some bowls are spoons. All spoons are plates.

**Conclusion 1:** Some spoons are bowls.

**Conclusion 2:** Some bowls are plates.
solution:
Given Statements:

Some bowls are spoons.

All spoons are plates.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a58fc125a863bbf53ec112052f66c1c144136c99c288fdcd564938b9e71436bf.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some spoons are bowls - **True** (Because, Some bowls are spoons implies that some part of the spoons overlap with the bowls).

II. Some bowls are plates - **True** (Because, All spoons are plates and some bowls are spoons, it means some part of the bowls, which are spoons, will also be plates).

So, Both conclusions (1) and (2) follow.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
